title: Google broke reCAPTCHA for de-googled Android users
summary: Google has broken reCAPTCHA verification for users running de-googled Android ROMs, making it difficult for privacy-conscious users to prove they're human on websites. The issue affects users of custom Android distributions like CalyxOS and GrapheneOS who have removed Google Play Services.
problem_solved: Reports on how Google's service changes are creating accessibility barriers for users who prefer privacy-focused, de-googled Android devices.
why_valuable: Highlights the tension between user privacy choices and service accessibility, raising awareness about vendor lock-in and digital exclusion.
